d: Donald Trump may have been missing from Canada's annual Parliamentary Press Gallery Dinner, but his impersonator made sure he was the centre of attention! A Trump lookalike took the stage, leaving the audience in splits with jokes aimed at both the US president and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney. Carney seized the opportunity to take playful digs at Trump, mocking his plans to revamp the Oval Office and calling him the 'new interior designer'.
